name: divide_32bit_by_16bit

name: multiply_32bit_and_swap_halves

name: call_exec_rawdofmt

name: count_string_length

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for the byte given as the second argument. It returns a pointer to the first match, or a null pointer if the terminator is reached first.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero to the caller without doing anything else. The routine only sets the result register.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string byte by byte to the destination, including the terminating zero. It returns nothing.

name: concatenate_zero_terminated_strings
description: Advances to the end of the first zero-terminated string and then copies the second string, including its terminator, onto that point. The first string therefore grows by the length of the second.

name: compare_strings_limited

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one to the caller and does nothing else. It is a fixed-value routine with no side effects.

name: scan_string_then_call_target
description: Walks a zero-terminated string for at most a given number of bytes. When it reaches the terminating zero it calls another routine, which the disassembly does not name, and otherwise returns without a call.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and then returns, so it passes control straight through. The forwarded target is left unnamed in the disassembly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:7:0092
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a buffer of a given length, stopping after the terminator. It then clears the remaining bytes of the buffer to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:10:0000
name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Turns a three-slot block into an empty linked list whose first link points to the slot after it, with the middle slot cleared and the last link pointing back to the block itself. This is the usual empty-list layout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:0000
name: process_record_field_chain
description: Returns one for a null record pointer. Otherwise it calls a generic routine with the constant twenty, and if that succeeds it makes two more calls, passing on the value stored at offset ten of the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:0082
name: walk_record_chain_until_failure
description: Follows the pointer stored at offset twelve of each record in a chain. For each record it calls a generic routine with the constant sixteen and with a count taken from a byte at offset seven multiplied by four, and it returns zero as soon as a call fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:00E2
name: return_one_success_stub
description: Returns one to the caller and performs no other work. It only sets the result register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:00E6
name: return_zero_failure_stub
description: Returns zero to the caller and performs no other work. It only sets the result register.

name: create_record_with_secondary_block
description: Allocates a twenty-byte record through a generic allocation routine and runs a follow-up operation on it. It then allocates a second block and stores its handle at offset ten of the record, returning the record or minus one when a step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:01BC
name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one to the caller and performs no other work. It only sets the result register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:01C4
name: build_record_chain_with_blocks
description: Library code that runs a counted loop in which each pass allocates a sixteen-byte record, links it to the previous record and attaches a second allocated block to it. It returns minus one as soon as any allocation or linking step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:020E
name: link_record_sequence_checked
description: Links a sequence of records together by storing each new record's address at a fixed offset in the previous one. It checks a second field of each record along the way and returns minus one when a step fails, or the first record when the chain ends cleanly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:0298
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns to the caller straight away without doing anything. It exists only as an empty routine that other code can call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Icon.Library:3:029C
name: return_minus_one_value
description: Returns minus one to the caller and performs no other work. It only sets the result register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:EndCLI:0:0136
name: copy_longs_then_call_handler
description: If the destination pointer is not null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table in the data area into it. It then calls the handler whose address is held in a register and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0000
name: initialize_program_state_and_start
description: Startup code that clears a block of twenty-three longwords, stores a register value and a global value into fixed slots, and calls a routine. Depending on the result it then calls one of two follow-on routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0004
name: run_greetings_timed_sequence
description: Runs a fixed series of calls on the program's global block, then pauses through the delay wrapper for two hundred fifty units and sets a flag before one final call. The nearby text is a list of greetings and thanks to other groups.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:021A
name: do_nothing_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing anything. It is an empty routine that only exists as a jump target.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0222
name: setup_dos_process_block
description: Allocates a cleared block whose size is a stored count times six, and on failure calls a routine with zero and returns. On success it fills in the block's fields, takes the current directory and the standard input and output from DOS, and passes the block to a further routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:035E
name: split_command_line_into_arguments
description: Builds an argument vector by copying a prefix string into a buffer and then splitting the remaining text into words at spaces and tabs. Double-quoted text is kept as one word, a pair of doubled quote characters stands for a literal quote, and a null pointer ends the array of word pointers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0532
name: append_zero_terminated_string
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about thirty-two thousand characters. It writes a terminator at the new end when the source was cut short and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:053A
name: append_string_up_to_count
description: Appends characters from a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most the given number of characters. It adds a terminator when the source was cut short and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:055E
name: copy_bounded_string_padded
description: Copies up to a given number of characters from a source string, stopping after its terminator, then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0580
name: open_library_and_bind_fields
description: Opens the library named in the program's data and, if that succeeds, reads a pointer from the second argument's structure and looks up a second library entry. It stores the results in fields of the first argument, closes the opened library, and clears the saved handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0632
name: forward_varargs_to_formatter
description: Passes its argument together with the address of its stack parameters to a formatting routine, along with a callback address. It forms the varargs-style entry point that the formatter needs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0634
name: forward_varargs_with_stack_pointer
description: Passes its argument together with the address of its stack parameters to another routine, in the same way as its neighbour. It discards the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0650
name: format_integer_as_digits
description: Converts an integer to text by repeatedly taking a digit from a lookup table and writing the digits backwards from the end of a buffer. A minus sign is placed in front when the value is negative.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:06D6
name: format_printf_style_string
description: Implements printf-style formatting: ordinary characters go to a character-output callback, and each percent specifier is parsed for flags, width and precision before emitting a character, decimal, octal, hexadecimal, string or integer conversion. It returns the count of characters written, or minus one if the callback fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A3A
name: divide_signed_with_sign_fix
description: Notes whether the two operands have opposite signs, calls a routine to do the unsigned work on their magnitudes, and then negates the result when the signs differed. The second operand's register value is returned alongside the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A7C
name: forward_call_preserving_register
description: Calls another routine and then returns with the second register value unchanged, passing back whatever the callee left in the first register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A88
name: forward_call_no_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and then returns, passing control through unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A92
name: divide_unsigned_32bit_values
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by an unsigned 32-bit divisor. A divisor that fits in 16 bits uses a single 16-bit division, while a larger one falls back to a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop, returning the quotient and remainder in two registers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AE2
name: forward_call_with_data_pointer
description: Calls another routine with its argument and the address of a fixed block in the program's data area, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AF8
name: write_char_flush_on_newline
description: Passes a character and a stream record to a write routine. When the character is ten, a line feed, and a flag bit in the record is set, it also calls a flush routine with a negative count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3C
name: no_op_return_stub
description: Returns to the caller without doing anything. It is an empty routine that only exists as a jump target.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3E
name: store_byte_in_buffer
description: Stores one byte in a buffer and advances the write position while there is room. When the buffer is full, it hands the byte to a flush routine and returns that routine's result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B6A
name: copy_record_byte_to_buffer
description: Copies the byte stored at offset eleven of a context record to the current buffer position and advances that position by one. It returns the copied byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B80
name: for_each_stream_record_call
description: Walks a fixed table of twenty-two-byte stream records from its start to its end, calling a generic routine on each record in turn.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BA8
name: close_stream_record
description: Closes a stream record that is in use and not null, flushing pending output when a flag is set, closing the handle and freeing its buffers as the flags direct. It then clears the record and returns the combined status, or minus one for a null pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BC4
name: release_stream_record_fields
description: Performs the same teardown steps as the neighbouring close routine, flushing, closing the handle and freeing the buffers according to the record's flag bits. It then clears the record's fields without checking for a null pointer and returns the accumulated status.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C2E
name: put_byte_to_stream_buffered
description: Writes one byte into a stream's buffer, allocating the buffer on first use and writing through the handle for an unbuffered stream. A write request of minus one flushes the stream and resets its pointers, and any failure sets the stream's error flag and returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C54
name: write_stream_byte_from_frame
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's stack frame to a stream, handling a flush request with a value of minus one first. On success it returns the value stored at offset twelve of the caller's frame, and on failure it sets the stream's error flag and returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C90
name: write_stream_byte_checked
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's frame to a stream, after first handling a flush request with a value of minus one. Buffered output is stored in the stream buffer, and a single unbuffered byte is written through the handle, with the stream marked as failed if that write does not complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CAA
name: write_stream_byte_direct
description: Writes the byte held in the caller's frame to a stream, using the buffer when its size is more than one and writing through the handle otherwise. A failed handle write sets the stream's error flag and returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CF0
name: store_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Sets the buffer start and end positions from the stream record, marks the record as buffered, and stores the frame byte at the write position before advancing it. It returns the stored byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D20
name: find_free_stream_record
description: Searches a fixed table of twenty-two-byte stream records for one whose in-use byte is zero, clears its three longword fields, and returns it. It returns a null pointer when every record is in use.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D48
name: scan_stream_table_for_free
description: Starts from the record pointer in an address register and scans forward through the stream table for an unused record, clearing its first three longwords when one is found. It returns a null pointer when no record is free.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D4A
name: clear_stream_record_fields
description: Sets the first three longwords of the record in an address register to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D58
name: allocate_stream_buffer_or_fallback
description: Allocates a 1024-byte buffer for a stream record, falling back to a one-byte buffer inside the record when allocation fails. It then calls a routine on the record's handle and sets a further flag bit when that call returns a non-zero result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D8A
name: attach_global_buffer_to_stream
description: Points a stream record at a shared 1024-byte buffer slot in the program's globals and marks the buffer as allocated. It also sets a further flag bit when a follow-up call on the record's handle returns a non-zero result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DB8
name: free_all_list_entries
description: Walks a singly linked list of allocated nodes and releases each one through a generic free routine, using the node's stored size plus eight bytes. It then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DC6
name: release_linked_nodes_until_null
description: Releases each node of a linked list in turn, passing the node address and its stored size plus eight bytes to a free routine. It clears the list head when the walk reaches the end and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DEA
name: allocate_and_link_list_node
description: Allocates a block sized to the argument plus eight bytes and stores the previous list head in its first longword and the argument in its second. The block then becomes the new list head, and the routine returns the address just past its eight-byte header, or a null pointer when allocation fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E16
name: push_node_onto_list_head
description: Pushes a node supplied in an address register onto the front of the list, storing the previous head in its first longword and a value from the caller's frame in its second. It returns the node address plus eight.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E2A
name: forward_call_single_argument
description: Calls another routine with its single argument and then returns to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E3A
name: unlink_and_free_list_node
description: Searches the list for the node whose data address matches the argument. When it finds one, it unlinks that node and releases it with its stored size plus eight bytes, returning zero, and returns minus one when no node matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E4A
name: unlink_and_free_frame_node
description: Locates the list node whose data address equals the value held in the caller's frame, unlinks it and releases it. It returns zero when the node is found and minus one when no node matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E66
name: unlink_list_node_at_position
description: Removes the node addressed by an address register from the list, updating the previous node's link or the list head, then releases it through a routine. It returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E6E
name: set_list_head_from_node
description: Makes the node in an address register the new list head and then calls another routine. It returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E86
name: check_slot_index_then_call
description: Checks that an index lies within the slot table and that the slot holds a value. An invalid index or an empty slot records error code two and returns minus one, otherwise the slot's contents are passed to a routine whose success gives a result of one and failure gives zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0EC4
name: test_slot_is_interactive
